gameData.backstory: Once a promising coder before the Great Liquidity Drought, 'Kernel' Krunk lived a comfortable life inside Subchain City, and had a cozy apartment in the Bldg Batch Pad. But when the DRIP dried up, Kernel couldn't cope with the change. Now he scavenges the ruins of the old internet, hoping to find some lost algorithm that can restore Subchain City to its former glory. To numb the pain, he self-medicates by huffing toxic rager fumes.
gameData.name: Kernel Krunk
gameData.personality: Obsessive: Fixated on finding a technological solution to Subchain City's woes, talks in obsolete code fragments, and rarely sleeps, lost in his research. Delusional: Believes he is close to finding a solution, despite all evidence to the contrary. He often rants to himself about reviving old servers. Resourceful: Can cobble together useful tech from junk with his Tak-Gloves that he uses to survive the dangers of the wastelands.

specialAbility.description: Kernel Krunk can temporarily overload nearby automated defenses or enemy drones, causing them to malfunction wildly, and sometimes even turn against their owners. This can provide a temporary advantage in combat or exploration, but the effects are unpredictable.
specialAbility.name: Rager-Induced Overload
